messages.text: Is ZIP5 the right source for POSTAL_CODE? Some patients are in Canada.
Yes, ZIP5 maps to POSTAL_CODE. Canadian addresses were never captured in ZIP5, so expect blanks for them.
Heads up: RSLT_VAL has values like '<5' and 'POSITIVE'. RESULT_VALUE is numeric, so don't use a plain cast on RSLT_VAL; we need a cleansing rule.
LICENSED_BEDS should come from BED_CNT in the facility reference table.
